title: Decolonizing the Stage: Exploring Postcolonial Narratives and Identity in Rohina Malik's Unveiled
core_idea: To explore the intersection of postcolonial criticism and contemporary literature through an in-depth analysis of Rohina Malik's play Unveiled, examining themes of identity, assimilation, cultural heritage, and resistance within postcolonial discourse by applying a theoretical framework informed by Said, Spivak, and Bhabha to interrogate stereotypes, power relations, marginalization, and questions of citizenship and belonging.
tldr: A postcolonial critical reading of Rohina Malik's Unveiled focused on identity, assimilation, cultural heritage, resistance, and debates over citizenship and belonging using Said, Spivak, and Bhabha.
